title: Sheinbaum Calls for INE 'Cleanup' as Electoral Supplier Corruption Scandal Widens
detail: During the week of Nov. 2-6, the Finance Ministry's Financial Intelligence Unit added 25 individuals and 15 companies linked to electoral suppliers to its Blocked Persons List, which requires banks to freeze their accounts, and filed a complaint with the Federal Attorney General's Office. The unit said listing does not establish liability. On Nov. 6, President Sheinbaum said the corruption at the National Electoral Institute (INE) predates Guadalupe Taddei's tenure and extended through Lorenzo Córdova's leadership and probably earlier, saying 'The INE has to be cleaned up.' She said a decree will strengthen the state printing agency Talleres Gráficos de México and that the scandal will not compromise the June 6, 2027 elections.
